title: Product catalogue · first draft
description: Scripted demo, step 1 of 3. A shopper requests a product and the API reads its price from the database. These components are proposals, not verified infrastructure.

title: Product catalogue · add a cache
description: Scripted demo, step 2 of 3. The design adds a cache to reduce repeated database reads. The outage age limit is still unknown; drawing a cache does not make prices fresh.

nodes.label: Product API
nodes.detail: Checks the cache before reading the database.

nodes.label: Price cache
nodes.detail: Missing detail: during an outage, how old may a cached price become?

title: Product catalogue · clarify the cache
description: Scripted demo, step 3 of 3. A proposed four-second age limit is now explicit. ArchRivet's separate review still needs all relevant facts and implementation tests before making a scoped decision.

nodes.label: Product API
nodes.detail: Checks the cache before reading the database.

nodes.label: Price cache · 4 s limit
nodes.detail: Proposed rule: do not serve prices older than four seconds, including outages. Test source freshness and enforcement separately.
